objective: Make NVDA/QQQ/SNDK persisted demo runs reliably servable through the existing COMQUTOR API/UI without rerunning TradingAgents or Provider semantics.

active_database_investigation.method: Read-only inspection of env resolution code, .env (key presence/scheme only, never full DSN or credentials), file mtimes, the sanctioned live-launcher script, and a direct read-only Postgres query using the project's own resolve_database_url()/repository code.
findings: COMQUTOR_DATABASE_URL is unset in this shell's exported environment (no ad-hoc override).

comqutor_alpha/storage/db/engine.py::resolve_database_url() falls back to a local SQLite file (outputs/runs/_comqutor_alpha_graph.db) whenever COMQUTOR_DATABASE_URL is empty/unset in the process environment.
outputs/runs/_comqutor_alpha_graph.db has mtime 2026-08-19 11:49 -- it has not been written to since that date.

All three candidate run directories were created after that date: NVDA (57d7b4c4-...) 2026-09-03, SNDK (e8e0f398-...) 2026-09-04, QQQ (f239a53f-...) 2026-09-11. None of their data could ever have reached the SQLite fallback file.
.env (repo root) DOES set a non-empty COMQUTOR_DATABASE_URL -- confirmed length 108 chars, scheme prefix 'postgresql+psyc' (full DSN never printed; credentials never inspected or logged).

scripts/start_live_comqutor.sh -- the one sanctioned launcher for live COMQUTOR research (per its own header comment) -- sources .env with `set -a` (auto-export) before starting comqutor-api, so any server started through it inherits the Postgres COMQUTOR_DATABASE_URL.

The comqutor-api server already running in this environment (PID confirmed via lsof on port 8000) reports via GET /ready: database=ready, real_execution=configured, live_semantic_pipeline=ready -- consistent with having been started through the correct, .env-sourcing launcher.

A direct read-only query against the Postgres DSN from .env (postgresql+psycopg://127.0.0.1:5433/comqutor_alpha, docker container 'comqutor-alpha--postgres-1' confirmed running) found COMPLETE rows for all three candidate run_ids across research_runs, research_run_progress, structure_graphs, alpha_conflicts (6 rows each, matching the 6 canonical taxonomy conflict pairs), agent_outputs, alpha_activations (10 rows each, matching the 10-Alpha MVP taxonomy), alpha_matches, and entity_alpha_exposures (10 rows each).

research_runs.status='completed' with a real, non-null completed_at timestamp for all three runs, each matching (to the second) the corresponding run_audit.json file artifact's own recorded completion time.
active_database_investigation.conclusion: The runs' data was never missing from the authoritative database. The Phase-1 audit's ad-hoc read checks (and/or any bare `comqutor-api` process started without .env loaded) resolved to the stale, irrelevant local SQLite fallback file instead of the Postgres database the sanctioned live-launcher (and the currently-running server) actually use and that already holds this data.

root_cause_classification.certainty: HIGH for 'the runs' authoritative data lives correctly in Postgres, not in the SQLite fallback used by Phase-1's checks' (directly proven by querying Postgres and finding complete, correct rows). MEDIUM for the precise mechanism of Phase-1's own check process (its exact environment was not captured/logged at the time, so this audit infers rather than directly observes that it lacked COMQUTOR_DATABASE_URL) -- not overstated as certain.
explicitly_not_concluded: ORIGINAL_PERSISTENCE_DEFECT is NOT the cause -- the original persistence succeeded correctly and completely in the authoritative DB.
POST_RUN_DB_DELETION is NOT the cause -- no evidence of deletion; rows are present, complete, and internally consistent.

CURRENT_DB_RESET_OR_REPLACED is NOT the cause for the authoritative (Postgres) DB -- it was never reset; only the unrelated, already-stale SQLite fallback file predates these runs, which is expected/by-design for a file that was never the active DB for these runs.

existing_restore_reindex_mechanisms_sear.found: No dedicated rehydrate/reindex/backfill/restore-from-artifacts write mechanism exists in the repository today. POST /api/replay-all (routes_replay_all.py) exists but creates NEW replay run_ids by reprocessing raw_agent_outputs.json through the current pipeline -- it does not, and was correctly NOT used to, restore/preserve the original accepted demo run_ids' own DB rows.
existing_restore_reindex_mechanisms_sear.conclusion: Moot in practice: because the empirical investigation (above) found the authoritative database already contains complete, correct rows for all three run_ids, no restore/reindex/rehydration mechanism -- existing or new -- was actually needed to close the P0 items.

rehydration_utility_rationale: The task anticipated needing a narrowly-scoped persisted-run rehydration utility (Section 8) if no adequate existing mechanism could restore missing DB rows from artifacts. Investigation (required first, in Section 3) disproved the premise: no DB rows are actually missing from the authoritative database for any of the three candidate runs. Building a rehydration/write utility for data that is not missing would be unnecessary, unauthorized-scope machinery carrying its own risk (a write path capable of inserting DB rows, however narrowly gated) for a problem that does not exist. The smallest safe fix for the real problem found -- an environment/DB-selection mismatch during ad-hoc verification -- is a read-only verification tool, not a write/rehydration tool.
mechanism_used: VERIFICATION_ONLY -- no persistence write/rehydration was necessary. A new read-only diagnostic script was added to make this verification repeatable and environment-safe going forward (see below).

code_files_added.purpose: Read-only operator/demo-preparation CLI. Loads .env the same safe way scripts/start_live_comqutor.sh does, then calls the exact existing, unmodified production read functions (get_research_run_status / build_research_response / get_persisted_structure_graph / get_persisted_conflicts from comqutor_alpha.api.routes_research) against a single explicitly-resolved read-only repository (build_repository_from_env). Classifies each requested run_id as FULLY_LIVE_SERVABLE / FILE_COMPLETE_DB_INCOMPLETE / DB_PRESENT_BUT_INCONSISTENT / FILE_INCOMPLETE / OTHER. Zero writes, zero Provider calls, zero TradingAgents calls, zero semantic recomputation. Reports the resolved database identity with credentials always redacted (scheme + host/db name only).

zero_provider_proof.basis: All verification was performed via read-only DB queries and read-only production GET-route function calls against already-persisted data. The new script imports no LLM/Provider/TradingAgents client. The new test's only pipeline execution is a synthetic, offline (offline_raw_agent_outputs) fixture using a separate throwaway run_id in an in-memory SQLite database, following the pre-existing test_graph_api.py/test_research_runs_api.py convention already used throughout this test suite -- it never touches the real NVDA/QQQ/SNDK run_ids, their files, or the real Postgres database.

QQQ.note: This is serving validation only, not a Gold reevaluation. A001's non-detected state and the A301__A304 main conflict are read verbatim from the existing, already-adjudicated persisted data -- nothing was recomputed.

p0_closure.P0_1_BASIS: QQQ (f239a53f-4ebe-455c-bb76-5f5485903901) is reliably live-servable via the existing, unmodified API/UI contract -- confirmed via both direct HTTP GET calls against the running comqutor-api server and the new in-process verification script -- with zero semantic recomputation.
p0_closure.P0_2_BASIS: NVDA, QQQ, and SNDK are all independently verified FULLY_LIVE_SERVABLE via the same method.

remaining_risks: If a future comqutor-api server is started without .env loaded (or without COMQUTOR_DATABASE_URL otherwise exported), it will silently resolve to the local SQLite fallback and reproduce the exact appearance of the Phase-1 finding -- not because data is missing, but because the wrong database is being queried. Operators should always start the server via scripts/start_live_comqutor.sh (or otherwise ensure COMQUTOR_DATABASE_URL is exported) for any demo-serving session, and can run scripts/verify_persisted_run_serveability.py <run_id> beforehand as a pre-demo check.

Whether other, non-candidate historical runs also depend on the same Postgres instance being up (docker container 'comqutor-alpha--postgres-1') was not exhaustively audited -- if that container is stopped, all three demo runs would revert to appearing NOT_READY, for the same underlying reason (DB unreachable / fallback resolution), not because their data changed.

The GraphPersistenceRepository's database_url is not publicly exposed as an attribute (confirmed private during this investigation); the verification script re-resolves it independently via resolve_database_url() rather than reading it off the repository instance, which is correct but means the two must be kept resolving identically if the resolution function is ever refactored.
not_authorized_actions_confirmed_avoided: No Gold v0.2 acceptance artifact modified.
No file fallback invented inside the user-facing GET routes (routes_research.py was not modified at all).
